turns.speaker: CLINICIAN
turns.text: Good morning! How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Good morning, Doctor. I've been having severe headaches for the past three weeks.

turns.speaker: CLINICIAN
turns.text: I see. Can you describe the headaches? Where do you feel the pain?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: It's mostly on the right side of my head, near my temple. The pain is throbbing and gets worse with bright lights.

turns.speaker: CLINICIAN
turns.text: On a scale of 1 to 10, how severe is the pain?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I'd say about 7 or 8 when it's at its worst.

turns.speaker: CLINICIAN
turns.text: Are you currently taking any medications?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yes, I take Lisinopril for blood pressure and sometimes ibuprofen for the headaches.

turns.speaker: CLINICIAN
turns.text: Do you have any allergies I should know about?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yes, I'm allergic to penicillin - it gives me a rash.

turns.speaker: CLINICIAN
turns.text: Good to know. Does anyone in your family have a history of migraines?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: My mother had chronic migraines, and my grandmother had them too.

turns.speaker: CLINICIAN
turns.text: Let me check your blood pressure. Please relax your arm.

turns.speaker: CLINICIAN
turns.text: Your blood pressure is 138 over 88, slightly elevated. Do you smoke or drink alcohol?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I quit smoking two years ago. I drink socially, maybe once or twice a week.
